page_review.title: Door
page_review.author: DJMaesen
page_review.download_modal_terms: Author must be credited. Commercial use is allowed.
page_review.visible_geometry: One dark industrial-style leaf inside a complete frame, lever handle at viewer left and hinge hardware at viewer right. Actual dimensions, separable source components and useful opening motion require local inspection.

local_payload.format_note: The newly downloaded 3.3 MB USDZ matches the page download option. The older Door.usdz from 2026-08-13 is a distinct, previously downloaded file and is preserved.

license_dependency_review: All five 2048 px texture maps are packaged inside this USDZ; the embedded scene metadata repeats the page CC-BY-4.0 author/source license. No external dependency or separately attributed third-party map was observed. This is source-specific evidence, not an independent author-chain audit.
duplicate_remote_review: Different source UID, visible design and author from the four accepted doors; confirm with local geometry fingerprint.

technical_review.explanation: At the maximum documented 2% uniform fit, a 0.8 mm latchward rigid shift removes leaf/fixed-hinge crossings. Three internal hinge pairs still have proper original-surface crossings at closed pose, especially moving hinge 7 versus fixed hinge 12 with about 27.8 mm vertical bounds overlap. A pivot change cannot remove a closed-pose overlap. No supported simple recipe adjustment resolves these without altering hinge geometry or collision treatment.
